title: Apple Inc. Form 10-K (synthetic)
text: Services mix reached 24% of total net sales, up from 22% in the prior year, with advertising, cloud, and payment fees the fastest legs. Greater China net sales were 17% of the company total and declined 6% year over year on weaker iPhone unit demand and a stronger Services mix that did not fully offset hardware. iPhone remained 51% of net sales. The company stated that Greater China remains a material concentration and that regulatory and competitive intensity there can move quarterly hardware units more than Services.
